items.raw_excerpt: Beloved by "Golden Age" Mexican movie stars, Hotel Mocambo in Veracruz was Mexico's first great luxury resort, and remains a treasure today.
items.summary_en: Hotel Mocambo in Veracruz was Mexico's first great luxury resort. It was beloved by Mexican movie stars of the Golden Age. The hotel still stands today and is considered a treasure.

items.raw_excerpt: Scientists have documented an extremely rare orange nurse shark discovered off Costa Rica’s Caribbean coast.
items.summary_en: Scientists have documented an extremely rare orange nurse shark off Costa Rica's Caribbean coast. The animal's unusual color drew attention from researchers. Such sightings are very uncommon.

items.raw_excerpt: El vocalista Pedro Barraza se defendió de las críticas por haber estado en el cierre del candidato republicano.

items.raw_excerpt: "Los fouls más mínimos se los cobraban (a ellos)", señaló tras la Intercontinental con Real Madrid.
items.summary_en: Lucas Avendaño is the captain of the U20 team at Santiago Wanderers. He spoke after the Intercontinental match against Real Madrid. He said even the smallest fouls were called against his team, and he called the referees shameful.
items.summary_ko: 루카스 아벤다뇨는 산티아고 완더러스 U20 팀의 주장이다. 그는 레알 마드리드와의 인터컨티넨털 경기가 끝난 뒤 "아주 사소한 파울까지 우리 팀에게 불어 줬다"고 말했다. 그는 심판 판정을 부끄러운 일이라고 비판했다.
items.title_en: Lucas Avendaño, Wanderers U20 captain: 'The referees were shameful'

items.title_original: Lucas Avendaño, capitán de Wanderers sub 20: Me molesta lo de los árbitros, es vergonzoso

items.raw_excerpt: The Personal Data Protection Commission said it is investigating the incident.
items.summary_en: The National Cancer Centre Singapore apologised after mistakenly exposing the email addresses of over 460 people. The personal data watchdog said it is now investigating the incident.

items.raw_excerpt: There’s something quite comforting about an old Range Rover.
items.summary_en: The L322 Range Rover is quickly becoming a modern classic car. Car lovers now see this older model as comfortable, charming, and worth collecting.

items.raw_excerpt: Bhutan has become the first country in WHO’s South-East Asia Region to eliminate dog-transmitted human rabies as a public health problem.
items.summary_en: Bhutan has eliminated dog-transmitted human rabies. It is the first country in the WHO South-East Asia Region to do this. This is a big public health win.

items.title_en: Bhutan is the first in South-East Asia to stop dog rabies

items.raw_excerpt: Karnataka increases II PU exam and related fees by 50%, affecting students in government and private colleges statewide.
items.summary_en: Karnataka has increased fees for the second pre-university (II PU) exam and other charges by 50% this academic year. The higher fees apply to students in both government and private colleges across the state.

items.raw_excerpt: A Kenyan startup has developed robotic hands that translate teachers’ voices into sign language, helping deaf students access classroom lessons even when teachers cannot sign.
items.summary_en: A Kenyan startup built robotic hands that change a teacher's voice into sign language. Deaf students can follow class lessons even when teachers cannot sign. The robot speaks through moving fingers and palms.

items.raw_excerpt: La Escuela de Gendarmería del "General Manuel Bulnes Prieto" hizo su aparición con alrededor de 94 efectivos. El desfile de los funcionarios marca la primera aparición de la institución en la tradicional ceremonia realizada desde 1819.
items.summary_en: About 94 officers from the Gendarmeria school joined Chile's traditional military parade. It was the first time the institution took part in the ceremony that has been held since 1819.
items.summary_ko: 일반 마누엘 불네스 프리에토 교도대학교 소속 약 94명이 칠레 전통 군사 퍼레이드에 나섰다. 1819년부터 열려 온 이 행사에 교도대가 처음으로 동참했다.

items.raw_excerpt: There is something about walking alone in Iceland that invites a different kind of listening. Away from the noise of everyday life, the landscape seems to make room for sounds that might otherwise go unnoticed: wind moving across open ground, waves breaking against black-sand shores, footsteps on gravel, or the distant murmur of a town…
items.summary_en: Walking alone in Iceland invites a different kind of listening. Away from daily noise, the landscape makes room for sounds like wind, waves, and footsteps on gravel. This playlist matches that quiet feeling.
items.summary_ko: 아이슬란드에서 혼자 걷다 보면 다른 방식의 듣기가 시작됩니다. 일상의 소음에서 벗어나면 바람이 평지를 가로지르는 소리, 검은 모래 해변에 부서지는 파도 소리, 자갈밭의 발걸음 소리가 더 또렷하게 들립니다. 이 음악 리스트는 그런 고요한 분위기에 어울립니다.

items.raw_excerpt: Dois endereços de prova foram alterados no município devido à necessidade de uso dos colégios estaduais para abrigar a população afetada pelos recentes eventos climáticos locais.
items.summary_en: Brazil changed two exam locations in Uniao da Vitoria. State schools are being used to shelter people affected by recent local climate disasters. So the exams must happen at new places.

items.raw_excerpt: Uusia pyöriä tulee ensin Paasikivenaukiolle, myöhemmin Keravan kartanolle.
items.summary_en: Kerava tested shared bikes without locks. One bike was found in Järvenpää, a nearby town. The others were vandalized, so new bikes will be put out, first at Paasikivenaukio and later at Kerava Manor.

items.title_en: Small town Kerava tried shared bikes that no one locks. One bike ended up in a nearby city, and the rest were wrecked.
